entities.summary: Sherali Khayrulloyev (b. 1949-11-08, Hamadoni District) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hamadoni District and Tajikistan. Known in the fields of tajikistan, military leaders & commanders, asia.
